# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.

# Acme Storefront

A small static shop site: six pages, shared CSS, no build step.

```
site/
  index.html  products.html  pricing.html  orders.html  about.html  contact.html
  css/tokens.css      design tokens and the web font
  css/base.css        reset, typography, layout
  css/components.css  header, button, card, form, table, modal
  css/pages.css       page sections
  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

The layout has one breakpoint, at 720px.

Sorted. The contact page was rendering wider than the viewport because of the support email address.

**Cause:** `[EMAIL]` is one long unbreakable string. In the "Other ways to reach us" card it spilled outside the card on desktop, and on phones its minimum width forced the whole contact grid wider than the screen — the page measured 424px in a 390px viewport, pushing the form inputs off the right edge. Other pages had no overflow.

**Fix:** added one rule in `site/css/pages.css:253`:

```css
.info-list dd {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

This lets the address wrap inside the card, so the grid can shrink to the viewport.

**Verified:**
- Contact page `scrollWidth` is now 390px at a 390px viewport (was 424px), and 1280px at 1280px.
- Screenshots at both widths show the form, inputs, card, and text all within bounds.
- Full functional suite: 16/16 passing.
